subject: Need a rate on a Knoxville to Atlanta partial
description: We have about 4,200 lbs of brake assemblies headed to the Atlanta DC next week. Can you quote it and tell me which carrier you'd use?

subject: BOL never came through on the Atlanta load
description: I never got the bill of lading for the Tuesday pickup. Our dock won't release without it.

subject: Grain load delivery window moved
description: The receiver in Columbus pushed our window to Thursday morning. Can the carrier still make it work?

subject: Detention charge on last week's haul
description: We got hit with a detention charge but our crew says the truck was late to the dock. Can you look into it?

subject: Need capacity for building materials to Charlotte
description: We've got a steady run of building materials to Charlotte starting in June. Can you hold capacity for us?

subject: Tracking link not updating
description: The tracking link you sent hasn't moved since yesterday morning. Is the shipment still on schedule?

subject: Carrier showed up without a liftgate
description: The driver pulled up with no liftgate and we have no forklift on site. Crew is stuck.

subject: Invoice has the wrong PO number
description: Your last invoice lists the wrong PO. Accounting can't process it until it's corrected.

subject: Can you move a reefer load of produce?
description: We have a temperature-controlled produce load to Nashville. Do you have a reefer carrier you trust?

subject: Rate increase question
description: Our Memphis lane rate went up this quarter. Can you walk me through what changed?

subject: Damaged pallet on delivery
description: Two cases came off the truck crushed. We took photos at receiving. How do we file a claim?

subject: Need proof of delivery for the Indy load
description: Our customer is asking for a signed POD on the Indianapolis delivery. Can you pull it?

subject: Add a second pickup stop
description: Can we add a second pickup in Maryville on the same truck before it heads north?

subject: Carrier insurance certificate request
description: Our compliance team needs a current COI for the carrier running our loads. Can you send it over?

subject: Load running late to St. Louis
description: The driver hit weather and is behind. Will this still deliver today or do we reschedule the dock?

subject: Setting up EDI for our orders
description: We'd like to send tender requests electronically going forward. Does your system support that?

subject: Fuel surcharge breakdown
description: Can you break out the fuel surcharge on our last three invoices? Our auditor flagged it.

subject: Quote on a flatbed to Memphis
description: We have steel racks that need a flatbed down to Memphis. What would that run us?

subject: Wrong delivery address on shipment
description: The truck got routed to our old warehouse. We moved locations in April. Can you redirect it?

subject: Hauling help for a family move
description: Floyd, this is Darrell. Got a load of equipment that needs to go from Harlan down your way. Got a carrier who can do me a favor on price?

subject: Question on the mentorship referral
description: Floyd, sending over a young broker who could use a hand on a tricky load. Can your dispatch team spare a few minutes with him?

subject: Accessorial charge dispute
description: There's a lumper fee on our invoice we never authorized. Can you check with the carrier?
